author: Wahiz
body:
Hello Avicus,

I am Dawson/Sheep_Ship,

Before this starts I know I have ban evaded A LOT but I need to have this 2nd chance. I love this server! Don't you see something? I ban evade (Yes I know its breaking rules) because I love this server. This server is where I belong.

Yes, Maybe some people may hate me on avicus because I am a douchebag at times. That is not the real me. If you ask the people who skype me, You would see that I am more than a big fluff head ban evading. It was stupid of me to get all of these infractions but I think I deserve another chance. You need to know something about me, I am person that you would never expect me to be. I can be the best person around and one of nicest. I can't believe I got those infrations. I feel like an absolute idiot to get so many. Please just take the time to consider on how much I love avicus. Yes, I understand if this gets denied but PLEASE! PLEASE I TELL YOU! I really need this second chance. To show the community I am not some idiot with no life. Avicus is so different; it is so unique. It is so much of every positive thing. I am sick of playing horrible servers that don't have different gamemodes.


I beg, For another chance.

-Dawson/Sheep_Ship

title: Please Think About This Appeal

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I'm sorry, but I can't really approve this appeal. It hasn't been long enough to appeal one ban, and it hasn't been long enough anyway to appeal a ban evasion punishment, which we recently implemented a strict policy on. I also cannot take your word for it, especially if you made a team emphasizing it called "Ban Evaders".

Appeal declined.
